entities.title: Block raw search and read commands, with a logged escape
entities.summary: A Claude Code hook refuses grep, find, cat and similar commands, the built-in Grep and Glob tools and the built-in Read of C# files, names the zazzle tool to use, and lets the agent bypass it for commands with # allow-raw, which is logged.
entities.context: Agents should read, search and edit files through zazzle, the front door, which asks the indexer for terse C# views, and ask the indexer for C# structure; an MCP server alone is easy for an agent to ignore.

options.title: Instructions only (initialize instructions and the AGENTS.md snippet)
options.consequences: Agents keep using their habitual shell commands.

options.title: A blocking PreToolUse hook with an escape hatch
options.consequences: Raw commands are turned into tool calls; the escape and every block show up in the usage log and in zazzle-csharp-indexer report.

entities.decision: init installs zazzle-csharp-indexer hook for Bash, Grep, Glob and Read; HookPolicy blocks the searching and reading commands and Read of .cs files only, points at zazzle_find, zazzle_ls or zazzle_read, and lets building, editing, following logs, reads of other files and commands marked # allow-raw through.
entities.rationale: The README's Quick start: zazzle is the front door, and the hook points at the matching zazzle tool. Reading a .cs file through zazzle gives the terse view instead of the source. Logging both blocks and escapes shows which redirects agents fight.
entities.origin: README.md, intro and Quick start; commit 5ea503c sent the redirects to zazzle and added Read.
